meta.name: github-fix-issue
meta.description: Fix GitHub issues end-to-end — analysis, branch creation, implementation, testing, and PR submission. Use whenever the user mentions fixing a GitHub issue, says "fix issue

copy.tagline: 自动分析问题、创建分支、实现修复并提交PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从GitHub issue出发完成修复并提交PR
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze issues, create branches, implement fixes, and submit PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to fix GitHub issues end-to-end and submit PRs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动分析 GitHub 问题、创建分支、编写代码、运行测试并提交拉取请求（PR），帮你完成从分析到修复的全流程。
howto.when: 当你提到修复某个 GitHub 问题，或说出“fix issue #123”、“work on this issue”等类似指令时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始分析该问题并执行修复流程。

say.text: 处理这个 GitHub 问题
say.note: Claude 会查看当前问题并制定修复计划。
Claude 会完成修复并提交拉取请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically analyze a GitHub issue, create a branch, implement the fix, run tests, and submit a pull request (PR), handling the entire process from analysis to submission.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention fixing a GitHub issue, or say phrases like "fix issue #123", "work on this issue", or reference a GitHub issue URL.

say_en.note: Claude will start analyzing the issue and execute the fix workflow.
Claude will examine the current issue and plan the fix.
Claude will complete the fix and submit a pull request.
